MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_ANDVARIS_CURSE.title: Andvari's Curse
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_ANDVARIS_CURSE.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
+{PerCurse} damage for each [gold]Curse[/gold] card you have in this combat, in any pile (max +{MaxBonus}).{InCombat:
(Now +{CurseBonus})|}
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_BROKEN_ON_SPEAR.desc:
Can only be played while [gold]Gram[/gold] is level 1 or higher.
This combat, Gram counts as {LevelLoss} level lower (Gram's effect and Gram cards' numbers drop with it).
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (spends a level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_DRAGON_BLOOD.title: Dragon's Blood
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_DRAGON_BLOOD.descrip:
This turn, whenever you play an Attack, gain {BloodBlock} [gold]Block[/gold] (Gram's level + 2).
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_THREE_YEARS.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
+{PerPair} damage for each time [gold]Pair[/gold] triggered this combat (max +{MaxBonus}).{InCombat:
(Pairs so far: {PairCount})|}
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_ALONE.title: Moye Alone
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_ALONE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If your [gold]current sword[/gold] was already Moye right before this card (you did not alternate), gain that Block again.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_FEMALE_BLADE_ONLY.de:
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Then choose Ganjiang or Moye to be your [gold]current sword[/gold]. This decides the next card's Pair and which effect (damage or Block) common cards carry.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (no level scaling).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_YAMATOHIME.title: Yamatohime's Gift
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_YAMATOHIME.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
+{PerLevel} damage per upgrade level of the sword [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] [gold]inherits[/gold].{InCombat:
(Now +{HeirBonus})|}
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_DOGYO_THEFT.desc:
If [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] is your [gold]current sword[/gold], choose another sword in your tomb: Kusanagi [gold]inherits[/gold] that sword's effect instead (no switch-in is used).
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 0 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_MISOGI.title: Misogi
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_MISOGI.descripti:
This combat, whenever [gold]Purification[/gold] reduces or removes one of your debuffs, draw {Draw} {Draw:plural:card|cards} and gain {MisogiBlock} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_DANNOURA.title: Sea of Dan-no-ura
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_DANNOURA.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have no switch-ins into [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] left after this card, deal it again.{InCombat:
(Switch-ins left now: {Remaining})|}
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_POLISH_RUST.title: Polishing the Rust
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_POLISH_RUST.descr:
This turn, [gold]Onimaru[/gold]'s end-of-turn auto attack never takes a random stance, and its damage (Block for Goei) is increased by {Polish}.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_CHAINED_ORDERS.de:
[gold]Command[/gold]: Whatever its stance, [gold]Onimaru[/gold] performs 1 [gold]Iai[/gold] on the target ({IaiDamage} damage). The stance does not change.
This Iai deals +{PerCommand} damage for each Command you already made this turn (max +{MaxBonus}).{InCombat:
(Now +{ChainBonus})|}
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_SHIFTING_STANCE.d:
This combat, whenever [gold]Onimaru[/gold]'s stance changes to a different stance, Onimaru immediately acts once more in the new stance.
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (its auto attack grows).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_GAIRECH.title: Battle of Gáirech
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_GAIRECH.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: For each enemy this kills, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_CLEAVE_HOST.des:
Costs 1 less for each enemy beyond the first (min 1).
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_CORMAC.title: Cormac's Restraint
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_CORMAC.descript:
This combat, whenever you play an Attack while only one enemy is left, gain {RestraintBlock} [gold]Block[/gold] (whatever your current sword is).
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block every 2 levels).
